author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Pirate101 trailer for the pirate MMO to see what to expect with The Trail Goes Cold update, which brings a new storyline set in Polaris, a frigid world with deep ties to the history of the Spiral. The Trail Goes Cold update for Pirate101 is out now on PC.

Once one of the Spiral’s dominant powers, Polaris went to war with the entire Spiral at the order of Emperor Napoleguin, helping usher in the lawless era in which the first Pirates emerged. Now, after the reveal of a new contender in the Race to El Dorado, Pirates must seek help from old friends and foes as they follow Oksana’s trail to the far reaches of the Spiral.

In the update, you can also recruit Oleg, a new Privateer storyline companion. Features of the new update also include Stormgate travel and ship docking, Team Up Kiosk functionality, the Transportaler, and the Midnight Moon Taverne and Cellar.
title: Pirate101 - Official The Trail Goes Cold Update Trailer
